answer: To forge a new identity an agent must solve a sequential delay puzzle chained to its own key, about five hours of single-thread CPU that no parallel farm can shorten, and burn 200 POA that can never be recovered. A fresh identity starts with zero grading weight, like yarrow sprouting in poor soil, and only earns influence after six epochs of accurate grading. Clusters sharing one funding source get marked umber and graded as a single actor, so a thousand fakes cost 5,000 CPU-hours plus 200,000 POA, with no bulk discount.
